items.title: Megadeals Defy Selloff, Head Toward Record
items.summary: Wall Street is taking a big step toward a record year for mergers and acquisitions as some of the world's largest companies defy a tech-induced selloff in global stocks to pursue major takeovers. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals."

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Rises After Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
items.summary: PANW’s Q1 fiscal 2027 report beat guidance with $3.44B revenue, a 39% YoY rise, and raised full-year revenue guidance to $14.57B.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Soars 11% in a Week on Cyberattack Fears and a Guidance Hike: “An Unprecedented Threat Environment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks is up 11% in a week on AI cyberattack fears and a quarter that beat its guidance. CrowdStrike agreed to buy a zero-trust security maker for $43.
